serve.description: Catalog discovery (change mcp-agui-a2ui-registry 1.1, decision D15). GET on this route returns the embedded mcp/ui/catalog/ipfs-mcp.catalog.json byte for byte as application/json; the catalog is embedded from that generated file and no copy of it exists anywhere else in the tree. The route lives under the AG-UI mount, so it exists only when /agui is mounted (--agui on, otherwise 404) and passes the same protection chain as /agui: Host check, Origin policy with the strict CORS answer scoped to agent.origin_allowlist, request body limit, bearer authentication, and the /agui default principal kind ui (an a2a or admin token gets 403). The catalogId above stays the A2UI identifier used in createSurface.catalogId; this route is only how an AG-UI client fetches the document. D15 scopes this phase to catalog discovery plus server-built surfaces, so the route serves the one published catalog and nothing model-composed.

aguiEvents.description: CUSTOM surface/catalog event names stay unchanged. Emit exactly one a2ui.catalog after RUN_STARTED only for an exact negotiated tuple and enabled agent.a2ui; value carries catalogId, catalogVersion, protocolVersion and catalogUrl from this descriptor. Surface events remain A2UI v0.9 messages. Missing/invalid/unmatched offers or disabled A2UI emit neither event, preserving ordinary tool/text output; external MCP resource delivery is independent.

description: A2UI component binding references. Catalog tools name a view component in ui.a2uiComponent; mcp/ui implements each component against the bound tools' output schemas and publishes the A2UI v0.9 catalog manifest. catalogId is the canonical A2UI catalog ID: a URI used only as an identifier, never fetched; it equals the manifest $id, and servers list it in supportedCatalogIds and use it in createSurface.catalogId. catalogAliases are short names for docs, logs and configuration; they are never sent as an A2UI catalogId. Chat components wrap every tool call in the agent chat; which chat elements apply to a tool is derived by the chatRules, never authored per tool. catalogVersion and protocolVersion define the exact first-party negotiation tuple. viewBindings is the only view/URI/file/default-component/allowlist authority; per-tool catalog ui.a2uiComponent chooses within that allowlist. mfs_read intentionally uses ContentCard inside the mfs view. Generate consumers and metadata from these sources, never maintain a second handwritten mapping.

negotiation.description: Validate this bounded namespace independently from the rest of forwardedProps. Missing, malformed, oversize, duplicate or incompatible offers disable first-party A2UI for this run; they never select HTML or change tool execution. Keep ordinary MCP resource negotiation and AG-UI text/structured results. No untrusted UAR CUSTOM surface passthrough.

externalApps.description: Preserve standard ui:// resources, _meta.ui.resourceUri plus legacy ui/resourceUri and the pinned ext-apps SDK. The namespaced exception declaration is informational resource metadata, not a sandbox permission, authentication claim or private handshake. It may be ignored by ordinary hosts. No nonce or custom response envelope is required.
